events.description: 50 failed login attempts detected from internal IP 192.168.1.100, indicating a potential automated brute-force or credential stuffing attempt.
events.action: Block or rate-limit IP 192.168.1.100, enforce MFA, reset credentials for targeted accounts, and investigate the host behind the local IP.

events.description: An internal host (10.0.0.55) initiated an unusually large data transfer of 15.5 GB, which may indicate data exfiltration, insider threat activity, or a compromised internal system.
events.action: Isolate the host at 10.0.0.55, inspect the source and destination of the data transfer, audit associated user credentials, and check for unauthorized access to sensitive datastores.

events.description: An internal host at 172.16.0.200 performed a high-volume port scan (1000 ports), which suggests network discovery or an internal compromise preparing for lateral movement.
events.action: Isolate host 172.16.0.200 from the network, check system logs for unauthorized processes, and verify if this IP belongs to an authorized vulnerability scanner.
